data.title: 远坂凛 · 学校天台
data.description: 放学后的穗群原学园天台上，凛双手扶着铁丝围网，俯瞰冬木市。深棕色双马尾随暮风轻舞；她侧过头望向同行者，嘴角浮起不肯直说关心的笑意。
data.action: 双手撑在铁丝网上俯瞰校园，双马尾在晚霞中随风轻舞
data.promptProse: Rin keeps both hands on the rooftop fence and smiles teasingly toward the viewer, wind lifting her twintails into the sunset’s warm edge.
data.animaCaption: Both hands remain on the fence as she turns back toward the viewer, her twintails lifted by the wind.
